lab.heading: Lab
lab.lead: Page for verifying shared components and in-app input-source auto-switching.
lab.switchTestLead: Focus each field in the native input window to switch via the same rule-matching and switch path as production (odd → Japanese, even → English). Same-process AX focus can be empty, so the Lab window also uses AppKit focus. Opening this page registers Lab rules automatically. Ensure auto-switch is enabled.
